author: Kat
title: Looking for human illustrator for short stories
content:
Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work.

NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art.

I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story.

What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives “Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark”. Maybe a little less intricate, but I want that “I’ve seen flashes of this in my dreams” creepy feeling?

Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration, because I don’t know but I want to do this the right way.

If you’re an artist who likes to read, even better! I’d like someone who might read the stories or parts of them and create what it made them feel.

I have most of one short done now, have 12 total planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator for publishing so someone with experience in that would be great too.

So if you’re an artist who doesn’t use AI & can be patient with me, please find this post. I want these stories to be done the right way, so they need a human illustrator.

Thank you! ♥ Contact via DM on Threads.
